items.action: mobile-native-kmp: getPortfolioAnalytics() truncates realtor portfolio at 100 listings — dashboard under-reports on large portfolios

mobile-native-kmp: getPortfolioAnalytics() fans out one analytics HTTP request per listing with no concurrency limit — up to 100 parallel GETs from a mobile device [retry 1/2 of failed code-review-mobile-native-kmp-portfolio-analytics-unbounded-fanout]
mobile-native-kmp: shared repositories swallow CancellationException in catch(e: Exception), breaking coroutine cancellation and showing spurious errors
mobile-native-kmp: SsoService (deep-link token exchange, login, password reset, session restore) has zero direct tests
mobile-native-kmp InquiriesResponse required page_size mismatches reality-server `limit` — MissingFieldException on every real /inquiries + /realtors/inquiries call
mobile-native-kmp shared Ktor HttpClient installs no HttpTimeout — every suspend API call can hang indefinitely on Android + iOS
KMP realtor CreateListingScreen onSubmit is a NotImplementedError stub — form data discarded
Unblock mobile-native/KMP builds in the cloud runner (issue #2652) — currently 6/9 open action-list items are structurally unclaimable in cloud, forcing Tier-1d generator kicks every run
screen-map-drift: PR #2894 touched reality-web routes without updating docs/scre

Land infra #2949 remediation — vendor swagger-ui as an in-repo asset (UTOIPA_SWAGGER_UI_DOWNLOAD_URL=file://...) so `cargo build -p api-server` succeeds behind the cloud egress proxy. Unblocks the IDOR trio (#2944/#2945/#2946) and every future api-server security patch.

Fix IDOR #2946 — apply the computed `org_id` as a scope filter in `portfolio_analytics::upsert_property_metrics` (routes/portfolio_analytics.rs:282) and `get_property_metrics` (:314); today both compute `let _org_id = user.tenant_id...` and discard it. Add sqlx cross-tenant regression test asserting Org B caller is 404 on Org A metric row.
Fix IDOR #2945 — verify org ownership of the target property/`building_id` in every portfolio_properties read+write handler before acting; add sqlx cross-tenant regression test.

Fix IDOR #2944 — enforce `org_id` scoping on violations comments/evidence/payments read paths AND gate internal-notes visibility behind Manager/Owner role (deny for Tenant). Add sqlx cross-tenant test + role-gate unit test.

Sweep for the `_org_id` / `_tenant_id` compute-then-discard anti-pattern across api-server (known sites: routes/portfolio_analytics.rs:282,314; routes/migration.rs:1472; routes/faults.rs:642). Convert each into a real scope check or add a `// SAFETY:` doc explaining the intentional discard; land a `just verify` grep gate against future reintroductions.

Resolve infra #2951 — align jest-expo with installed react-native@0.87 (or pin RN back to 0.85 per CLAUDE.md) and regenerate the mobile lockfile so the jest suite loads in the cloud runner. PR #2950 merged red-CI because of this; every future mobile-rn security patch will land the same way until fixed.

Add device-handoff integration test companion to PR #2950 — log in Tenant A, seed each newly-covered namespace (`@ppt/access_log`, `@ppt/qr_scan_history`, `@ppt/feedback_drafts`, `@ppt/pending_feedback`, `@ppt/faq_votes`), log in Tenant B, assert no read-back. Guards against regression when a new tenant-scoped cache is added without updating `TENANT_SCOPED_EXACT_KEYS`.
Resolve cargo-deny RUSTSEC-2026-0258 (h2 empty-DATA-frame DoS) — watch the h2 release feed and bump to a patched release; remove the waiver in `.cargo-deny.toml`. Standing since 2026-08-18.
